name: ai-insertion-detector
description: Detects and records qualifying AI-generated code insertion events.

commands.title: AI Insertion Detector: Open Provenance Search
AI Provenance: Switch to Backend Mode
AI Provenance: Refresh Local Lineage (Latest Commit)

aiCodeProvenance.mode.description: Choose storage and features: local (zero-setup) or backend (full power).

aiInsertionDetector.enabled.description: Enable or disable AI insertion detection.

aiInsertionDetector.lineThreshold.description: Minimum net added lines required before an insertion event is captured.

aiInsertionDetector.proxyPort.description: Proxy port used when forwarding captured insertion payloads via HTTP POST.

aiInsertionDetector.localProxy.enabled.description: Enable or disable the local LLM HTTP proxy that intercepts outgoing POST calls.

aiInsertionDetector.localProxy.port.description: Listening port for the local LLM proxy server.

aiInsertionDetector.correlation.similari.description: Minimum Levenshtein similarity score used to boost content-based request correlation when timing matches are ambiguous.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.baseUrl.description: Base URL for provenance backend APIs used by the sidebar, for example GET /provenance/{uuid} and POST /explain.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.websocketUrl.description: WebSocket endpoint used for primary backend capture ingest.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.ingestPath.description: Relative backend path used for HTTP fallback ingest when WebSocket delivery fails.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.loginPa.description: Relative backend authentication endpoint used by the login command when requesting JWT tokens.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.registe.description: Relative backend registration endpoint used when creating new per-user accounts from the extension.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.refresh.description: Relative backend endpoint used to refresh expired access tokens using a refresh token.
How many seconds before token expiration the extension should proactively refresh access tokens.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.autoAcq.description: Attempt backend authentication preflight on extension activation using any stored JWT token.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.retry.websoc.description: Maximum number of WebSocket ingest attempts before switching to HTTP fallback.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.retry.httpAt.description: Maximum number of HTTP fallback ingest attempts after WebSocket failures.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.vectorSearch.description: Relative backend endpoint path for vector similarity search used by the provenance search panel.

aiInsertionDetector.local.explanation.pr.description: Local explanation mode: templated summary (default) or local Ollama request with templated fallback.

aiInsertionDetector.local.ollama.url.description: Local Ollama generate endpoint used for local provenance explanations.

aiInsertionDetector.local.ollama.model.description: Ollama model name used for local provenance explanation generation.

aiInsertionDetector.local.ollama.timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for local Ollama explanation requests.
